data.name: Corrupted Companion
data.description: A blighted myrmidon can call upon a corrupted servant of nature. When the blighted myrmidon chooses the second fiendish boon option, it functions as a summon nature's ally spell of the appropriate level. This ability otherwise functions as the standard fiendish boon antipaladin class feature. This alters fiendish boon.
